Model CC-BMS8, serial CCB-8001 and location Level 1 BMS room agree across the construction register, equipment schedule, commissioning certificate and warranty. No possible tag matches or correspondence refer to this asset.

exceptions.finding: No row for BMS-01 exists in the FM register (CAFM import), so Readiness 2.1 fails.

exceptions.finding: No preventive maintenance plan can exist because there is no FM record (Readiness 2.5).
exceptions.next_action: Configure a PPM plan once the FM record is created.

findings.summary: BMS-01 has a signed, passing commissioning certificate (COM-11), a warranty valid to 2028-10-29 with matching serial (WAR-11) and an O&M manual (OM-09), and its identity is consistent across all sources. It is missing from the FM register and so has no PPM plan; both are internal fixes for the FM CAFM administrator. It cannot be 'Ready for review' until they are done.
